name: Issue 5740: a level 5 Runemaster casts Palm Sigil: Fire after casting Runeshroud
contract: The report: a level 5 Runemaster cannot cast Palm Sigil: Fire 534803 while stealthed in Runeshroud 500288.
534803 (BaseLevel 4) has CasterAuraSpell 808089 'Runeshroud or Waveforged', which SyncRuneshroudOrWaveforged
applies when Runeshroud 500288 (BaseLevel 4) is applied, so a character who casts Runeshroud for real
must pass the caster-aura gate and receive the 534803 aura. Outside Runeshroud the cast is refused with

steps.label: SETUP: outside Runeshroud the cast is refused with 'You can't do that yet'
SETUP: the Runeshroud cast applies the aura
SETUP: Runeshroud opens the Palm Sigil gate
CONTRACT: inside Runeshroud Palm Sigil: Fire completes at level 5
